map_frame.label: 5 km offset square map frame

git.runtime: Python 3, matplotlib, numpy, shapely; no Colab/online tiles required once QA CSV and display cache are present

qa.ward_layer: historical OSM/Kathmandu Living Labs 33 wards, not certified authoritative current 2026 ward boundary

scientific_boundary: Display built from V02.0 geometrically assigned ward aggregate counts + generalized historical polygons. Full-precision point-in-polygon QA is inherited, not rerun in v02.1. Ward assignment discrepancies and polygon authority unresolved. Do not promote to final publication.
